spec.name: Trend v35
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.5, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 14%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation. While the signal itself appears reasonable (a delayed, summed return), the lack of robustness testing raises concerns. The inclusion of transaction costs is positive, but insufficient to offset the full-sample risk. Paper trading is required to assess out-of-sample performance and confirm the claimed metrics before considering deployment.
